mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which in turn negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a quarter indicates a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.5% in a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% in a month signals increased demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances where HOUST increased by more than 5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals increased economic activity, which leads to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for 3 consecutive months, signals a stable economic environment conducive to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the periods where CPIAUCSL remained below 2% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 0.5% and 1% respectively in a month signals a robust labor market, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases > 0.5% and PAYEMS increases > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.5% and PAYEMS increased by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 2% in a month signals a contraction in consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS decreased by more than 2% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) and an increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 1% and 0.5% respectively in a month signals supply-side constraints leading to inflationary pressures, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases > 1% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO decreased by more than 1% and CPIAUCSL increased by more than 0.5% in a month.
